paintings.title: Your momentum friend
paintings.description: Music fast, times slow. Behind my shades, small gestures I read as vain. Wash me away Deformed time! For I am nothing. In a place without time, in a soul without hope

paintings.title: Promises of silence
paintings.description: A desire to scream freedom, burns deep inside of me, in every conversation, taking away my posible friends, a hymn of freedom like drums like bells, strips me from fear, sets me alone, the next day I mourn, making future promises of silence, until I regain strength one more.
